settings.editor:
Welcome to RV PU College, Harohalli (RV PU Harohalli), where our mission is to provide a positive learning environment that encourages students to reach their full potential.

We are a pre-university college, offering comprehensive education to prepare young adults for their university studies. Our college offers an excellent learning environment, featuring experienced and knowledgeable faculty, modern facilities and abundant resources. We strive to provide our students with the best academic and personal growth opportunities so that they can become well-rounded and successful individuals.

We have opened doors to learning across Bengaluru, with campuses thoughtfully located to bring quality education closer to you. Each branch carries the same commitment to academic excellence, holistic growth and a student-first environment, yet each has a unique culture shaped by its community and surroundings.

Whether you seek an energetic academic hub, a calm learning atmosphere or a space that balances creativity and discipline, you’ll find a campus that feels just right. Explore our centres, learn what makes them special and choose the environment that empowers you to grow, achieve and thrive.

From academic achievements and cultural celebrations to sports victories, student-led initiatives and inspiring guest sessions, our campus is always alive with energy, creativity and talent. Dive into the experiences that define student life at RVPU Harohalli.

  body, .elementor-page-2 {

<script>
(function() {
  function setupInfiniteCarousel(widgetSelector, prevSelector, nextSelector, desktopCount, isEvents) {
    const widget = document.querySelector(widgetSelector);
    if (!widget || widget.dataset.rvpuCarouselInit === '1') return;
    const wrapper = widget.querySelector('.swiper-wrapper');
    const container = widget.querySelector('.elementor-image-carousel-wrapper');
    if (!wrapper || !container) return;

    widget.dataset.rvpuCarouselInit = '1';

    if (container.swiper && typeof container.swiper.destroy === 'function') {
      try { container.swiper.destroy(false, false); } catch (e) {}
    }

    container.style.overflow = 'hidden';
    wrapper.style.display = 'flex';
    wrapper.style.willChange = 'transform';

    let isAnimating = false;
    let slideWidth = 260;
    let gap = isEvents ? 22 : 24;

    function getVisibleCount() {
      const vw = window.innerWidth || 1280;
      if (vw <= 767) return 1;
      if (vw <= 1024) return isEvents ? 3 : 2;
      return desktopCount;
    }

    function applyPositions(offsetIndex) {
      const visibleCount = getVisibleCount();
      gap = visibleCount === 1 ? 12 : (isEvents ? 22 : 24);
      const slides = Array.from(wrapper.querySelectorAll('.swiper-slide'));
      const totalWidth = container.clientWidth || 320;
      slideWidth = (totalWidth - gap * (visibleCount - 1)) / visibleCount;
      slides.forEach((s, idx) => {
        s.style.flex = '0 0 ' + slideWidth + 'px';
        s.style.width = slideWidth + 'px';
        s.style.marginRight = gap + 'px';
        s.style.boxSizing = 'border-box';
        if (isEvents) {
          s.classList.remove('rvpu-pos-0', 'rvpu-pos-1', 'rvpu-pos-2', 'rvpu-pos-3', 'rvpu-pos-4');
          const rel = idx - offsetIndex;
          if (visibleCount === 1) {
            if (rel === 0) s.classList.add('rvpu-pos-2');
          } else if (visibleCount === 3) {
            if (rel === 0) s.classList.add('rvpu-pos-1');
            else if (rel === 1) s.classList.add('rvpu-pos-2');
            else if (rel === 2) s.classList.add('rvpu-pos-3');
          } else if (rel >= 0 && rel < 5) {
            s.classList.add('rvpu-pos-' + rel);
          }
        }
      });
    }

    function nextSlide() {
      if (isAnimating) return;
      isAnimating = true;
      applyPositions(1);
      const stepPx = slideWidth + gap;
      wrapper.style.transition = 'transform 0.55s cubic-bezier(0.25, 0.8, 0.25, 1)';
      wrapper.style.transform = 'translate3d(-' + stepPx + 'px, 0, 0)';
      setTimeout(function() {
        wrapper.style.transition = 'none';
        if (wrapper.firstElementChild) {
          wrapper.appendChild(wrapper.firstElementChild);
        }
        wrapper.style.transform = 'translate3d(0, 0, 0)';
        applyPositions(0);
        isAnimating = false;
      }, 560);
    }

    function prevSlide() {
      if (isAnimating) return;
      isAnimating = true;
      const stepPx = slideWidth + gap;
      wrapper.style.transition = 'none';
      if (wrapper.lastElementChild) {
        wrapper.insertBefore(wrapper.lastElementChild, wrapper.firstElementChild);
      }
      applyPositions(1);
      wrapper.style.transform = 'translate3d(-' + stepPx + 'px, 0, 0)';
      void wrapper.offsetHeight;
      wrapper.style.transition = 'transform 0.55s cubic-bezier(0.25, 0.8, 0.25, 1)';
      wrapper.style.transform = 'translate3d(0, 0, 0)';
      applyPositions(0);
      setTimeout(function() {
        isAnimating = false;
      }, 560);
    }

    applyPositions(0);
    wrapper.style.transform = 'translate3d(0, 0, 0)';
    window.addEventListener('resize', function() {
      if (!isAnimating) applyPositions(0);
    });

    if (prevSelector) {
      document.querySelectorAll(prevSelector).forEach(function(btn) {
        btn.addEventListener('click', function(e) {
          e.preventDefault();
          prevSlide();
          resetTimer();
        });
      });
    }
    if (nextSelector) {
      document.querySelectorAll(nextSelector).forEach(function(btn) {
        btn.addEventListener('click', function(e) {
          e.preventDefault();
          nextSlide();
          resetTimer();
        });
      });
    }

    // Touch Swipe Support for Mobile & Tablet
    let touchStartX = 0;
    container.addEventListener('touchstart', function(e) {
      if (e.touches && e.touches.length) {
        touchStartX = e.touches[0].clientX;
        clearInterval(timer);
      }
    }, { passive: true });
    container.addEventListener('touchend', function(e) {
      if (e.changedTouches && e.changedTouches.length) {
        const diff = e.changedTouches[0].clientX - touchStartX;
        if (Math.abs(diff) > 35) {
          if (diff < 0) nextSlide();
          else prevSlide();
        }
        resetTimer();
      }
    }, { passive: true });

    let timer = setInterval(nextSlide, 2700);
    function resetTimer() {
      clearInterval(timer);
      timer = setInterval(nextSlide, 2700);
    }
    container.addEventListener('mouseenter', function() { clearInterval(timer); });
    container.addEventListener('mouseleave', function() { resetTimer(); });
  }

  function initAll() {
    setupInfiniteCarousel('.rvpu-results-carousel', '.rvpu-results-prev', '.rvpu-results-next', 4, false);
    setupInfiniteCarousel('.rvpu-events-carousel', '.rvpu-events-prev', '.rvpu-events-next', 5, true);
  }

  if (document.readyState === 'loading') {
    document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function() { setTimeout(initAll, 250); });
  } else {
    setTimeout(initAll, 250);
  }
  window.addEventListener('load', function() { setTimeout(initAll, 400); });
})();
</script>
